CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_rcp(vehiclereg VARCHAR)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
    SELECT CASE WHEN (distdonekm + distleftkm) > 0 
        THEN ROUND((distdonekm * 100.0 / (distdonekm + distleftkm)), 2)
        ELSE NULL END
    FROM transportinfo
    WHERE vehiclereg = $1;
$$ LANGUAGE SQL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_rcp(p_vehiclereg character varying) RETURNS character varying AS $$
    SELECT CASE 
        WHEN distdonekm + distleftkm > 0 AND ROUND((distdonekm * 100.0 / (distdonekm + distleftkm)), 2) >= 100 THEN 'Complete'
        WHEN distdonekm + distleftkm > 0 THEN 'In Progress'
        ELSE NULL
    END
    FROM transportinfo
    WHERE vehiclereg = p_vehiclereg;
$$ LANGUAGE SQL;
